نتوافد (form VI)
# نَتَوَافَدُ (natawāfadu) /na.ta.waː.fa.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَوَافَدَ (tawāfada)
# نَتَوَافَدَ (natawāfada) /na.ta.waː.fa.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَوَافَدَ (tawāfada)
# نَتَوَافَدْ (natawāfad) /na.ta.waː.fad/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَوَافَدَ (tawāfada)
